description.title: הגדרות פוליסה
description.summary: This table defines key terms used in the insurance policy. It helps to understand the scope of coverage by clarifying what different terms mean within the context of the policy.
description.embed_passage: טבלה זו מציגה הגדרות חשובות בפוליסת ביטוח אחריות זיהום של 'Named Insured'. ההגדרות מסייעות להבין את תנאי הפוליסה, כגון מה נחשב ל'Loss' או 'Insured', ומהם 'Microbial substance' ו'spores'. הפוליסה מגדירה 'Bodily injury', 'Property damage', 'fungus(i)', 'bacteria', 'viruses', ו'Named insured'. ההגדרות רלוונטיות לחישוב פיצויים במקרה של נזק או תביעה.  הטבלה מגדירה גם את המונחים 'spores', 'bacteria', 'fungus(i)', 'viruses', 'Named insured', 'Loss', 'Bodily injury', ו'Property damage'.
notable_values: Named insured: Item 1 of the Declarations

sketch:
N. "Loss" means:
Compensatory damages, whether awarded by a court in a judgment or paid in settlement for:
(a) 'Bodily injury"; or
(b) 'Property damage'; and
"Loss" does not include "other loss".
"Microbial  substance" means  any  substance  that  reproduces  through  release  of "spores"  or  the  splitting  of  cells  including  but  not  limited  to  bacteria,  viruses, "fungus(i)", protozoa, chlamydiae, or rickkettsaie, whether or not the substance is living.
"Named insured" means the person or entity set forth in Item 1 of the Declarations, and  any  other  person  or  entity  listed  in  a  Named  Insured  endorsement  to  the policy, if any.
